1345.0.0.description:
Log TestSuite PostRun failure for results publishing

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the test-suite post-run outcome for results publishing. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1345.1001.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1345.1001.1.description:
Copy using tftp - Negative tests

[Log-derived analysis] Negative-path validation of TFTP file copy. Attempts wildcard TFTP copies to an unreachable address and copies of non-existent files to a valid server, and confirms the operation fails cleanly with an appropriate error rather than reporting success or hanging. Verifies the running-config is unchanged after teardown and no exceptions occur.

1345.1001.2.description:
Create directories of various lengths

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies directory creation across a range of nesting depths. Creates progressively deeper directory trees, copies a test file into directories at each depth, and confirms each copy succeeds and the file is listed in the target directory.

1345.1001.3.description:
SD Card large file support

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies large-file support on an inserted SD card. Repeatedly moves a multi-gigabyte file into and back out of a nested directory tree on the card and confirms each move reports success and the file remains intact at the expected size in its destination.

1345.1001.4.description:
Copy using scp

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies file copy over SCP to a remote host. Clears any stale known-host key, initiates an SCP copy, accepts the host key fingerprint on first connection, authenticates, and confirms the file lands on the SCP destination. Verifies config integrity and absence of exceptions after teardown.

1345.1001.5.description:
USB Media large file support

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies large-file support on inserted USB media. Repeatedly moves a multi-gigabyte file into and back out of a nested directory tree on the USB stick and confirms each move reports success and the file remains intact at the expected size.

1345.1001.2359.description:
Test file copy

[Log-derived analysis] Basic file-copy verification. Copies a file and confirms the source and destination have identical contents.

1345.1001.2361.description:
Test copy to existing file

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies copy-to-existing-file overwrite handling. Declines the overwrite prompt and confirms the destination is left unchanged, then accepts and confirms the destination then matches the source.

1345.1001.2362.description:
Test copy from different extension name

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies copying preserves contents across differing file extensions. Copies a file to one with a different extension and confirms the contents match the source.

1345.1001.2364.description:
Command copy, move - insufficient space, Device hanged up after an attempt to fill the Flash with 1000 files

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies graceful handling when the flash filesystem is full. Fills flash with copies of a file until out of space, confirms copy and move report the correct out-of-space error, and confirms the device does not hang after the filesystem-full condition.

1345.1001.2366.description:
Test copy to special extension named files

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies copying to files with assorted (special) extension names. Copies a source file to destinations bearing various extensions and confirms each copy is identical to the source.

1345.1001.2367.description:
Test copy with full path source-name to a file

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies copy using a fully-qualified source path to a destination file. Confirms the copied file is identical to the full-path source.

1345.1001.2368.description:
Test copy with full path source-name to a directory

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies copy using a fully-qualified source path into a directory. Confirms the file copied into the target directory is identical to the source.

1345.1001.2369.description:
Test copy with source and destination with full path-names also in stacked directories

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies copy with full path-names for both source and destination, including within stacked/nested directories. Confirms each copied file is identical to the source.

1345.1001.2377.description:
Test file delete, zero sized file, non-existant, space in file name

[Log-derived analysis] Exercises file deletion edge cases: deleting a normal file, a zero-sized file, a non-existent file (expecting the correct file-not-found error), and a file whose name contains spaces. Confirms each behaves correctly.

1345.1001.2385.description:
Test file move, non-existant file, zero sized file

[Log-derived analysis] Exercises file move edge cases: moving a normal file (source removed, destination has the contents), moving a non-existent file (expecting the correct error), and moving a zero-sized file. Confirms each behaves correctly.

1345.1001.2397.description:
Show file - Various tests

[Log-derived analysis] Exercises the show-file command across cases: an ordinary text file, a non-text file, a non-existent file, a text file inside a directory, an empty file, and a one-byte file. Confirms correct output for each.

1345.1001.2398.description:
Test multiple file creations, deletions, copies and moves

[Log-derived analysis] Stress test of bulk file operations. Creates many files, moves each to a new name, then deletes them, confirming all files are created, renamed, and removed as expected with no leftover files.

1345.1001.2410.description:
mkdir, rmdir on NVS

[Log-derived analysis] Exercises mkdir/rmdir behaviour on the NVS filesystem. Creates a nested directory tree, verifies recursive directory listing and current-directory tracking, then confirms rmdir refuses non-empty directories while delete-force/recursive removes directories and their contents correctly.

1345.1001.2415.description:
Move dir - various tests

[Log-derived analysis] Exercises moving directories. Moves a directory with files into a non-existent target and into an existing target, confirming the directory and its contents are relocated correctly and the original directory is removed.

1345.1001.2424.description:
dir and file names - max number of characters

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies maximum filename/directory length handling. Confirms a name at the maximum length is accepted for mkdir and file creation, a name one character over the limit is rejected with the correct error, and creating an over-length file via output redirection fails without hanging the device.

1345.1001.2438.description:
Test copy and move commands on read only source files

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies copy and move operate correctly when the source file is read-only. Moves and copies a read-only file and confirms the resulting files have the same contents as the original.

1345.1001.2439.description:
Test copy and move commands on read only destination files

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies copy and move operate correctly when the destination file is read-only. Copies and moves over a read-only destination and confirms the resulting contents match the source.

1345.1001.2444.description:
Check non-authorised file commands at exec-user level

[Log-derived analysis] Security check that file-manipulation (execute) commands are not available at the unprivileged exec-user level. Confirms no such commands exist at that privilege level.

1345.1001.2449.description:
Copy using tftp

[Log-derived analysis] Broad TFTP copy verification. Exercises plain TFTP copy in both directions, copy into a server folder with and without write permission (expecting permission-denied where appropriate), and wildcard multi-file copies, confirming correct success and error reporting and that copied files match the originals.

1345.1001.36790.description:
Using '..' gives user access to internal linux files

[Log-derived analysis] Security check that path traversal using '..' cannot reach the internal Linux filesystem. Confirms show-file and dir on a '../etc' style path are rejected and do not expose internal files.

1345.1001.36796.description:
File System commands don't work if an asterisk character is used

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies wildcard ('*') handling in file commands. Confirms copy, delete and move with a wildcard correctly match and operate on the intended set of files (including copying to NVS) without error.

1345.1001.37086.description:
Aborting delete command gives no output

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that aborting a delete command produces appropriate output. Declines the deletion prompt and confirms the device reports that the deletion was aborted and the file was not deleted.

1345.1001.37239.description:
Unable to delete file deep within sub-directory tree at particular command format

[Log-derived analysis] Regression check for deleting a file deep within a sub-directory tree. Confirms that a particular delete command format prompts correctly for the source file name rather than failing.

1345.1001.37244.description:
Device hangs up when creating file '.' or '/'

[Log-derived analysis] Regression check that creating a file named '.' or '/' (via output redirection) does not hang the device. Confirms the correct error is returned and the device stays responsive.

1345.1001.37265.description:
Incorrect path shown in CLI for destination folder not found error message

[Log-derived analysis] Regression check that the destination path shown in a 'directory not found' error is correct. Attempts a move to a non-present media destination and confirms the error reports the correct path.

1345.1001.37267.description:
Check for correct ouput on command 'sh file card or usb'

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies correct output for show-file against non-existent files on card and USB media. Confirms each reports a proper does-not-exist message.

1345.1001.37268.description:
'show file system' lists card when it is not available

[Log-derived analysis] Regression check that 'show file system' does not list an SD-card slot when no card is present. Confirms the card slot is absent from the listing.

1345.1001.37269.description:
Device hanged up after an attempt to fill the Flash with 1000 files

[Inferred behavior — no execution history for this case] Intended to confirm the device does not hang up after an attempt to fill the flash filesystem with a large number (1000) of files. Best-effort intent: fills flash to capacity and verifies the device remains responsive and handles the filesystem-full condition gracefully.

1345.1001.37302.description:
Check for correct error when moving a directory to itself

[Log-derived analysis] Regression check for the error when moving a directory onto itself. Confirms the device reports that source and destination are the same rather than incorrect output.

1345.1001.37332.description:
Delete force command on bad hostname

[Log-derived analysis] Regression check for 'delete force' with a bad hostname in the URL. Confirms the command completes without incorrectly prompting for a source file name.

1345.1001.37361.description:
Unhelpful error message when copying to card that is not present.

[Log-derived analysis] Regression check for the error message when copying to an SD card that is not present. Confirms a clear 'destination directory not found' message is given.

1345.1001.37395.description:
VCS URL filesystem naming. The hostname part of URL is only length checked.

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify VCS URL filesystem naming where only the hostname portion of the URL is length-checked. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires a VCS stack.

1345.1001.37469.description:
Segmentation fault while editing a file on a vcs member greater than highest ID present.

[Log-derived analysis] Regression check that editing a file on a VCS member ID higher than the highest present does not cause a segmentation fault. Confirms a proper error is returned instead of crashing.

1345.1001.37584.description:
Delete force of a directory - doesn't produce an error message

[Log-derived analysis] Regression check that 'delete force' on a directory produces an error message. Confirms the device reports that the target is a directory and that delete recursive is required, rather than silently failing.

1345.1001.37620.description:
Bad error message appears since new filesystem project delivery

[Log-derived analysis] Regression check for a bad error message on malformed dir input. Confirms a dir command with an invalid character returns the correct 'invalid character used in url' error.

1345.1001.37719.description:
Deleting folder with space in it

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies deletion of a directory whose name contains a space. Confirms the device can cd into the folder and that delete recursive removes it successfully.

1345.1001.37957.description:
Use of wildcard with copy and move produces file with * as a filename

[Log-derived analysis] Regression check that wildcard ('*') used as a copy/move destination does not create a file literally named with the wildcard. Confirms the correct error is given and no '*' file is created.

1345.1001.38669.description:
Http copy on an invalid ip address gives no error message

[Log-derived analysis] Regression check that an HTTP copy from an invalid IP address returns an error. Confirms the device reports it is unable to resolve/reach the address rather than silently producing no output.

1345.1001.39608.description:
Copy file from SD card to stack member

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify copying a file from an SD card to a stack member. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires a multi-member stack.

1345.1001.39820.description:
Copy file from card to stack member

[Inferred behavior — no execution history for this case] Intended to verify copying a file from an SD card to a stack member. Best-effort intent: copies a file from the inserted card to another stack member and confirms it arrives intact.

1345.1001.40092.description:
Move command with '?'

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies command help ('?') output for the move command across each filesystem target (flash, card, nvs, usb). Confirms the expected destination options are listed and an incomplete command is reported when no destination is given.

1345.1001.80656.description:
Confirm release file can be set

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the boot release (software) image file can be set. Downloads a release file to flash, sets it via 'boot system', and confirms the boot image is recorded correctly in the boot configuration.

1345.1001.373610.description:
Unhelpful error message when copying to usb that is not present.

[Log-derived analysis] Regression check for the error message when copying to USB media that is not present. Confirms a clear 'destination directory not found' message is given.

1345.1001.396080.description:
Move file from SD card to stack member

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify moving a file from an SD card to a stack member. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires a multi-member stack.

1345.1001.396081.description:
Copy file from USB media to stack member

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify copying a file from USB media to a stack member. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires a multi-member stack.

1345.1001.396082.description:
Move file from USB media to stack member

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify moving a file from USB media to a stack member. Reported UNSUPPORTED because it requires a multi-member stack.

1345.1001.806560.description:
Confirm release backup file can be set

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the backup boot release image can be set. Downloads a release file to flash, sets it via 'boot system backup', and confirms the backup boot image is recorded correctly in the boot configuration.
